ACI-WORKFLOW-BINDING-V1:
Read-only. Find the existing discovery that most directly defines this invariant: one human-confirmed canonical dispatch structure is transported forward, persisted, used to derive the subagents-dispatch.yaml record, and interpreted to provision agents, prompts, communication permissions, scheduling, loops, and terminal behavior without the chat parent. Inventory plausible discovery files under docs/features/agents-communication-infra/discovery and the related research target. Return: (1) primary discovery; (2) exact supporting file:line evidence; (3) secondary/companion discoveries and what each owns; (4) whether the primary should be rewritten or a new discovery is needed. Do not modify files. Keep the answer under 1500 tokens.

ACI-WORKFLOW-BINDING-V1:
Read-only. Trace the formal authority chain for the user's invariant across ACI discovery and SPEC documents: skill/generated proposal -> confirmed canonical structure -> persistence -> agent invocation plans -> message/routing/scheduling -> subagents-dispatch.yaml projection. Focus on ownership and exact terminology. Return: (1) which discovery is the correct rewrite target; (2) exact file:line citations; (3) which claims are already ratified in SPEC versus only proposed; (4) any naming or boundary correction needed. Do not modify files. Keep the answer under 1500 tokens.

ACI-WORKFLOW-BINDING-V1:
Read-only, adversarial audit. Assume the claim that one existing discovery already defines the whole invariant may be overstated. Compare the candidate skill-protocol, invocation/collaboration, bus/routing, and dispatch-ledger/cutover discoveries. Find contradictions, maturity mismatches, or split ownership. Return: (1) strongest primary rewrite target, if any; (2) exact file:line evidence; (3) what must be imported from companion discoveries; (4) whether rewriting one discovery would create duplicate authority. Do not modify files. Keep the answer under 1500 tokens.
